name: Sneak Attack
trigger: You hit with a finesse or ranged weapon
description: Once per turn, add the Sneak Attack dice as extra damage to one creature you hit. The attack must use a finesse or ranged weapon, and you need either advantage on the attack roll, or another enemy of the target within 5 ft of it that is not incapacitated, with you having no disadvantage on the roll.

name: Cunning Action
description: Each turn you have a bonus action that can be used only for Dash, Disengage or Hide.

name: Uncanny Dodge
trigger: An attacker you can see hits you
description: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to halve the damage of that attack.

name: Stroke of Luck
trigger: Your attack misses, or you fail an ability check
description: A missed attack against a target in range becomes a hit. Or a failed ability check counts as a natural 20 on the d20.
Needs a short or long rest before it can be used again.

name: Fast Hands
description: Your Cunning Action bonus action can pay for any of these: a Sleight of Hand check, disarming a trap or opening a lock with thieves' tools, or the Use an Object action.

name: Thief's Reflexes
description: Combat's opening round gives you an extra turn: act once on your usual initiative count, then again 10 counts lower. Being surprised cancels this.

name: Assassinate
trigger: Attacking a foe that hasn't acted yet
description: Strike first and hard. Until a creature has had its first turn of the fight, your attack rolls against it have advantage. Against a surprised creature, every hit you land counts as a critical hit.

name: Death Strike
description: Hit a surprised creature and it must pass a Constitution save. The DC is 8, plus your proficiency bonus, plus your Dexterity modifier. If it fails, your attack deals double damage.

name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
description: You always know mage hand as an Arcane Trickster. Cast it and the hand can be invisible. It can also stow an item into someone else's container, fetch one out, or pick locks and disarm traps from a distance using thieves' tools.
Beat the creature's Wisdom (Perception) with a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check and these tasks go unnoticed. Controlling the hand takes your Cunning Action bonus action.

name: Magical Ambush
trigger: You cast a spell on a creature while hidden from it
description: Cast a spell at a creature that can't see you (you are hidden from it) and that creature has disadvantage on its saves against the spell for the rest of the turn.

name: Versatile Trickster
description: Use your mage hand to distract. Pick a creature within 5 ft of the hand. You have advantage on attack rolls against it until the end of this turn.

name: Spell Thief
trigger: A spell targets you or catches you in its area
description: Right after the spell is cast, spend your reaction: the caster saves with its spellcasting ability modifier against your spell save DC.

If it fails, the spell does nothing to you. A spell of level 1 or higher that you have slots for (any class's list) is now yours for 8 hours, cast with your own slots, while the caster loses the use of it for those 8 hours.
Recharges on a long rest.

name: Rakish Audacity
trigger: You attack a lone foe next to you
description: Add your Charisma modifier to your initiative rolls.

You can also Sneak Attack without advantage, provided the target is within 5 ft of you, nobody else is within 5 ft of you, and the attack roll isn't at disadvantage. All the usual Sneak Attack rules still apply.

name: Panache
description: Action: make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by a creature's Wisdom (Insight) check. It only works on a creature that can hear you and that shares a language with you.

Hostile creature, you win: for 1 minute it has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you, and can't make opportunity attacks against anyone but you. It ends early if one of your companions attacks it or affects it with a spell, or if you and it end up more than 60 ft apart.
Non-hostile creature, you win: for 1 minute you have it charmed, and it sees you as a friendly acquaintance. Harming it in any way, by you or your companions, ends the charm at once.

name: Elegant Maneuver
description: Bonus action: your next Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check this turn is made with advantage.

name: Master Duelist
trigger: You miss with an attack roll
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Roll the missed attack again, with advantage.
